tasks.title: Extract ChangesPanel component
tasks.description: Extract the inline diff/commits JSX block (~110 lines, lines 417-525 in IssueDetailPage.tsx) into a standalone `ChangesPanel` component. Props: files, commits, diffTab/setDiffTab, expandedFiles/setExpandedFiles, expandedCommits/setExpandedCommits, onCommitExpand. Always render the panel (remove the early-return null guard). Show 'No changes yet' empty state when both arrays are empty. Add a summary header line computing file count, additions, deletions, and commit count from the props.
acceptanceCriteria: ChangesPanel renders with same Files/Commits tabs and expandable diff behavior as before
Summary header shows file count, +additions, -deletions, commit count computed from props
Empty state shows 'No changes yet' when files and commits are both empty
IssueDetailPage renders ChangesPanel in the old position with same behavior
DIFF_STAGES constant and showDiff guard are NOT yet removed (keep existing behavior)
tasks.notes: This is a pure extract refactor — no behavior change yet. The panel is used in-place of the old inline JSX in IssueDetailPage.

ChangesPanel appears after Description and before TaskList in the JSX order

ChangesPanel renders in Explore, Plan, Build, Check, Done stages

tasks.title: Add changes summary to inline approval sections in sidebar

Note: PlanApprovalPanel and ReviewApprovalPanel components exist but are NOT used in IssueDetailPage — the approval UI is inline JSX, so the summary goes there.
acceptanceCriteria: Compact changes summary renders in the Plan-stage approval gate section in sidebar
Compact changes summary renders in the Check-stage approval gate section in sidebar
